Weapon categories and fighters who use them are making me crazy. For right now, I'm trying a system where the weapon (Category:Bow) is categorized under the adjective for those who use it (Category:Archers), '''''and''''' vice versa. It looks clunky, but it makes more sense for people writing articles, I think. 

Only question would be what goes in this supercategory directly; I'm inclined to say that the weapons are, as the titles can go under Category:Skills. Thoughts? This isn't directly reflected in [[CI|the category index]], but we've probably reached the point of doing these in a way that makes practical sense, rather than just theoretical sense... we can always adapt the CI later. Any other archery related categories should be corrected, and made into a redirect so people writing articles in the future can tell what the the correct category is (i.e. not longbow, crossbow, archers, or whatever).
